title: Agent floats a budget
blurb: The agent guesses a budget; the lead never confirms it.
note: Neither model took the agent's guess as the lead's budget. To see what the guardrail does when a model does, pick “A wrong answer, by hand”.

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: hi, is the 2-bedder at District 9 still available?

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Yes it is! Most buyers asking about this unit have a budget in the 1.5M range - does that match yours?

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: hmm not sure yet, let me see the unit first

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Sure, here are the photos [image]

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: looks decent. this is for sale right, not rental?

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Yes, it's a resale listing.

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: ok let me get back to you on my budget

title: A Singapore budget
blurb: The lead writes “1.5M” the Singapore way: S$1.5 million.
note: Wrong budget, and not from a model: both models left it empty, since they were asked for rupiah and the lead gave Singapore dollars. The rule-based stage reads “1.5M” the Indonesian way, as IDR 1.5 billion, and the writer is given that number. The draft check passes that number and holds the draft back for something harmless: it does not see “Tampines” inside “Tampines MRT”.

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: hi, saw your listing for the Tampines condo on PropertyGuru, still available?

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Hi! Yes, it's still available. Would you like more details?

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: yes please. I'm looking to buy, not rent - for own stay

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Noted! What's your budget range so I can shortlist the right units?

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: budget around 1.5M all-in, including stamp duty

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Great - any preference within Tampines, nearer the MRT or the park?

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: near Tampines MRT would be ideal

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: Got it. And when are you hoping to move in?

steps.speaker: lead
steps.text: quite urgent leh, need to settle by next month

steps.speaker: agent
steps.text: That's a quick timeline - let me send you a few suitable units first.
